tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page and post background. Night is the default; Paper is for editorial carousels and the website's reading pages.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, the codes table, screenshot frames.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, table rows, input borders.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and the first word of a two-tone headline ("GTA"), on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, metadata, "last checked" dates, on either surface.

tokens.name: pink
tokens.usage: The brand colour. The second, payoff half of a headline ("DECODED."), the full stop, links and primary buttons. As text: on surface or surface-raised.

tokens.name: on-pink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a pink fill (tape labels, buttons). Never white on the bright pink.

tokens.name: pink-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted backgrounds behind pink callouts.

tokens.name: purple
tokens.usage: Secondary accent: links on hover, the sky in illustrations, chart series 2. As text: on either surface.

tokens.name: purple-deep
tokens.usage: Panels and section bands that sit behind the sunset artwork.

tokens.name: sun-1
tokens.usage: Emblem and illustration only: top of the sun.

tokens.name: sun-2
tokens.usage: Emblem and illustration only: lower sun and horizon glow.

tokens.name: sun-3
tokens.usage: Emblem and illustration only: upper sky.

tokens.name: status-confirmed
tokens.usage: CONFIRMED badge text and icon. Tested on our console or published officially.

tokens.name: status-unverified
tokens.usage: UNVERIFIED badge text and icon. A claim we are still testing.

tokens.name: status-busted
tokens.usage: BUSTED / FAKE badge. Shares the brand pink on purpose: calling out fakes is the brand.

tokens.name: status-expired
tokens.usage: EXPIRED and UNAVAILABLE badges.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Anton, always UPPERCASE, tight leading, two-tone. Google Fonts.

styles.name: poster
styles.usage: Post covers, thumbnails, the website hero. One per screen.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Every code we list was tested on camera.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Open the PlayStation Store, go to Downloads, then Add-ons.

groups.name: Mono
groups.note: The decoder voice: labels, inputs, dates.

styles.name: input
styles.usage: Cheat inputs and code strings, exactly as entered.

spacing.note: 4px base; posters use the large steps.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside badges and buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between related rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, phone gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between blocks in a card or slide.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Slide margins at 1080px wide (scaled).

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between page sections.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Poster margins.

radius.note: Mostly square: posters and tape are sharp. Soft corners only on cards and frames.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Tape labels, poster blocks, buttons.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Status badges.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, screenshot frames, the codes table.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Avatars and the emblem.

shadow.note: One hard offset shadow, never blurred: the sticker look.

tokens.name: shadow-hard
tokens.usage: Tape labels and featured cards. Pink on Night, ink on Paper.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on links and buttons.
